title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT IS CONVINCED THAT HE HAS AT LAST FOUND HIS IDEAL
summary_hover: Left alone at Saville Row, Passepartout inspects his new quarters and rejoices at the strict, clockwork routine of his new master.
summary_detail: Following Mr. Fogg's departure, Passepartout explores the meticulously organized house at Saville Row. He discovers a detailed daily schedule, electric clocks, and a numbered wardrobe system. Delighted by this predictable, machine-like environment, Passepartout feels he has finally found the tranquil home he has been seeking.
